column1: # Which ChEBI roles admit a compound to this corpus.
# NOT YET READ BY THE PIPELINE. ChEBI is currently a grounding and occurrence
# source: a compound enters from MIBiG and ChEBI supplies its identity. The
# admission route these rows describe — an allow-listed role admitting a
# compound MIBiG never saw — needs the role edges from ChEBI's relation.tsv,
# which the extractor does not read yet (#23). The decisions below are recorded
# now because they are the argument, not the plumbing.
# INCOMPLETE BY DESIGN. The YES rows are a starting set, not a survey: ChEBI's
# role hierarchy has many more specialized-metabolite roles and each needs its
# own decision. Adding one is a reviewed change measured by what ELSE that role
# admits corpus-wide, never a one-compound tweak — a role is a lever on
# thousands of records.
# The NO rows are as important as the YES rows and are kept rather than omitted,
# because "why is bacterial metabolite refused?" is the question that separates
# this corpus from a metabolite dump. See PLAN.md 2.2 and issue #9.
